Voice & gestures

Navigate with your voice.

Hand tracking runs on your device. Voice uses the browser’s speech service, which may process audio online. This site does not record or store audio or camera frames.

Voice

“Open PlayStation”

Say Open and a project name: Merlin, Rios, PlayStation, Vodafone, Tracr, Gala or Bastion.

NextPreviousWorkAboutContactSettingsMenuIndexListBackScroll upScroll down

“Menu”, “Index” and “List” open the project list.

For scrolling, “Up”, “Down”, “Move up” and “Move down” also work. Each command moves part of a page, or scrolls the open project list.

A complete command activates immediately. A short pause finishes the phrase. Listening pauses while the action runs, then resumes.

Next and Previous work inside a project. Say “Stop listening” to switch voice off.

Gestures

  • PointIndex and middle fingers together; ring and little fingers tucked. Extend your thumb away to make an L-shape. Move your hand to move the cursor.
  • ClickPoint at a card or button, then touch your thumb to both fingertips. The pointed item locks before contact and activates once. Release your thumb to point again.
  • ScrollHold your open hand flat like a wing until the scroll control appears. Tip the fingers down to scroll down, showing the back of your hand; tip them up to scroll up, showing your palm. More tilt moves faster. Flatten or close the hand to stop. Point again before clicking.
  • BackFrom a closed hand, briefly open your palm, then close it before the scroll control appears. This also reverses a transition. Closing after a click or during scrolling only releases.
  • Next / previousSwipe the two joined fingers left for next, right for previous.

Enable your microphone after OK. Voice uses the browser’s speech service.
